stories.title: Seattle officials question FD over ambulance contractor, AI-assisted 911 triage
stories.simple_summary: Seattle officials are questioning whether the fire department's use of AI to help answer 911 calls is working well for the ambulance service that responds to emergencies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you call 911, this affects how quickly help reaches you — it's worth paying attention to whether your city's system works properly.

stories.title: Japan’s AI satellites and other space ambitions ‘a serious threat’, China warns
stories.simple_summary: China says Japan is developing AI satellites for space and views this as a threat to China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to governments and international relations — it doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: For years they warned AI could kill all humans. Now people are listening.
stories.simple_summary: Researchers who have been warning for years that AI could become dangerous are now getting more attention from the public and decision-makers.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't change anything immediately, but it means AI safety is becoming a bigger conversation in society.

stories.title: Commission Urges UK to Overhaul Regulation of AI Medicine
stories.simple_summary: A UK commission is telling the government it needs to create better rules for AI systems used in medicine and healthcare.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use healthcare in the UK, this could eventually mean AI medical tools are safer and better checked before doctors use them.

stories.title: ‘For 2 years, we’ve held our tongues’: Democrats clap back at 1 of Silicon Valley’s biggest donors
stories.simple_summary: Democratic politicians are publicly disagreeing with one of Silicon Valley's biggest business leaders and donors.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political story — nothing that directly affects you unless you follow political news closely.

stories.title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
stories.simple_summary: A startup called Listen Labs turned down a $1.5 billion investment offer because it wants to talk to Salesforce (a big software company) instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — it's not relevant to ordinary people or small-business owners.

stories.title: Can humans stay in control of AI?
stories.simple_summary: The BBC is asking the question: can people stay in charge of AI systems, or will AI systems make their own decisions?
stories.why_it_matters: This is a general question being debated — it doesn't announce any specific change, just that people are thinking about control and safety.

stories.title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI has hired a researcher named Paul Christiano who is known for worrying that AI could become dangerous and hard to control.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows OpenAI is bringing in experts to think about safety — it's a sign they take risks seriously, but mostly relevant to people following AI industry news.

stories.title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
stories.simple_summary: Massachusetts has passed new rules that make it harder and more expensive to build data centers (huge computer buildings that power AI and internet services).
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually mean AI services and cloud computing cost more in Massachusetts, which might affect small businesses that use those services.

stories.title: Suno releases its first AI music model made with record industry help
stories.simple_summary: Suno, a company that makes AI music, released a new version trained using data that record companies agreed to share with them legally.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI music tools are now working with the music industry instead of against it — if you use AI music tools, this means fewer legal worries.

stories.title: OpenAI’s sly mathematical breakthrough sends a chill through academia
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced that AI has solved a very difficult math problem that mathematicians have been trying to crack for decades.
stories.why_it_matters: This is impressive for math and science, but it mostly matters to researchers and mathematicians — it won't change your daily life soon.

stories.title: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy
stories.simple_summary: Apple explained how its new iPhone features can listen to sounds around you (like sirens or babies crying) while still keeping your private conversations private.
stories.why_it_matters: If you buy a new iPhone, you should read Apple's explanation to understand what data stays on your phone versus what gets sent elsewhere.
